faq.q: Does my plan pay for my visits?
faq.a: No. Your plan pays for Jachi's help. You pay each provider for the care you choose, at the self-pay price we confirm with you before booking.

faq.q: How fast will my coordinator reply?
faq.a: Within 1 business day on Concierge, and the same day on Concierge Plus (weekdays) and Signature (7 days a week). If we miss it, your next month is free.

faq.q: Can I choose my own provider?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us who you'd like to see and we'll book it, or we can suggest options near you. The choice is always yours.

faq.q: Where does my health information go?
faq.a: Your medical records stay with your provider. Jachi keeps what it needs to run your membership and book your visits, and the checkout and help chat never ask for health details.

faq.q: What does the AI assistant do?
faq.a: It answers general questions about Jachi and how memberships work, and it always says it's AI. It never gives medical advice. Your coordinator is a real person.

faq.q: Can I switch plans or cancel?
